title: Trace sub-view client (FBS-208, TAC-4136, ADR-4140)
description: page-init.js IIFE Trace matrix section: wireTraceMatrix + fetchAndRenderTrace + renderTraceRoot + buildMatrixRowsFromPayload + renderMatrixHtml. Fetches ./trace.json?id=<pivot>&includeCode=1 and ./coverage.json?scope=<REQ>, caches by (version, pivot), falls back to prior-version render stale on an SSE tree-update (AC-209-4), distinguishes 404 unknown-pivot from 5xx fetch-error, guards callbacks against hash-pivot change, routes readiness-tab lookup picks to the Trace sub-tab.
